_comment: Regression cases for search_native_tools, phrased the way a model states its own sub-goal. expect: the target that must appear in the top 3. not_offered: a left-out tool whose answer must appear. none: no target may match. These are written by the same hand as the keywords, so they guard against regressions; they do not measure real-world accuracy.
